answer.text:
For marketing emails at GitLab GTM Ops, you should use the regular marketing email flow as outlined in the handbook. Email creation and nurture programs are managed by the Campaigns Team, and all emails sent should be updated in the All-Marketing SSOT Calendar. For more details on policies and processes, refer to the Email Management page and the Emails/Nurture Handbook in the demand generation section.

There is a section in the handbook specifically for requesting, creating, and approving new email templates; however, this section is currently under construction and does not provide a finalized process or template at this time. Until that process is published, you should continue to follow the regular marketing email flow.

For best practices on email creation (such as subject lines, preheader text, and link tokens), refer to the Beefree page.

Owner: Marketing Operations (@manav-gl, @anramirez) and Campaigns Team  
Sources: [marketing/marketing-operations/_index#email-management], [marketing/marketing-operations/email-management/_index#overview], [marketing/marketing-operations/email-management/_index#requesting-creating-and-approving-new-email-templates], [marketing/marketing-operations/beefree/index#quick-best-practices]

Email Management
nodes.text: Marketing Ops is responsible for maintaining the email marketing database. Go to the [Email Management Page](/handbook/marketing/marketing-operations/email-management) for policies and more detailed information.

nodes.label: Quick best practices
nodes.text:
1. Always build from a template, rather than from cloning

2. Utilize the saved modules from the folders, rather than building from scratch where possible. If you have a new module in mind, ask @aklatzkin or @cbaun for support.

3. Ensure you're using the right modules for footer & hero based on if you're using Marketo vs. Iterable:
   * The Iterable version will have `{{utm}}`, `{{email}}`, `{{unsubscribeUrl}}`, `{{viewInBrowserUrl}}`
   * The Marketo version will have `{{my.utm}}`, `{{my.email address}}`, `{{system.unsubscribeLink}}`, `{{system.viewasWebPageLink}}`

nodes.label: Overview
nodes.text:
Email database management is a core responsibility for MktgOps. Ensuring GitLab is following email best practices, in compliance with Global spam laws and overall health of active database are all priorities.

Email creation and email nurture programs are managed by the Campaigns Team. To learn more about GitLab email communication or request an email, please see the [Emails/Nurture Handbook](/handbook/marketing/lifecycle-marketing/emails-nurture/) in the demand generation section of the handbook.

All emails sent should be updated in the [FY23 All-Marketing SSOT Calendar](/handbook/marketing/#marketing-calendar-inputs)
